title: Confessions
author: augustine
attributionNote: The attribution is recorded as the edition and the scholarly consensus give it; where the attribution is disputed, the work says so.
description: Augustine's account of his life before and after his conversion, written as a prayer. Books I–IX narrate his youth, his years as a Manichaean hearer and his baptism; Books X–XIII turn to memory, time and the interpretation of Genesis.
historicalContext: Written while Augustine was bishop of Hippo, in the years between the Manichaean and Donatist controversies that shaped much of his later writing.
availabilityNote: Streamed from the Christian Classics Ethereal Library at read time. Pusey's 1838 translation, served by the CCEL. The Latin original is not hosted in this streaming edition.
